# Velocity Queue Plugin
![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-17+-blue)
![Velocity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Velocity-Proxy-yellow)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green)
![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/github-repo-green?style=flat)

*by Nico*


## Introduction

This plugin is heavily inspired by [**Velocity Limbo Handler**](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/velocity-limbo-handler.122570/),  
but it is **entirely original** and **not copied**, so it is **not under the GPL-3.0 license** of that plugin.

### Why I created this plugin

The original [**Velocity Limbo Handler**](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/velocity-limbo-handler.122570/) worked well,  
but some features, like `pause-when-empty-seconds`, didn't behave as expected on Paper servers.  
I created this plugin to provide similar functionality with full control, while keeping it fully original.


## Setup

1. Drop the plugin `.jar` into your Velocity `plugins` folder.  
2. Configure your **Limbo server** and **Target server** in the `config.yml`.  
3. Start/restart your proxy. The plugin will handle the queue automatically.

> The plugin automatically manages player queueing, action bars, and server redirection.


## Commands

All commands automatically apply to `owner` or `admin` groups.  


### `/queue flush`

**Description:**  
Immediately redirects all players in the queue to the target server.  

**Usage:**  
```bash
/queue flush
